label: ayanesanabeach3
title_zh: 它终将索取我们所有人

lines.en: : Did you really play that game the entire day? Your battery didn’t, like...die or anything?
lines.zh: : 你真的玩了整整一天？你的电池就没……那个，没掉电什么的？

lines.en: : I brought...a charger and...there was an outlet in the bathroom...
lines.zh: : 我带了……充电器，而且……洗手间里有插座……
: 好吧，不过……你眼睛不疼吗？
: 我现在都快……看不见了……

lines.en: I wind up in the back of Ayane’s limo again with no recollection of how I got here. But such things are no longer of much concern to me.
lines.zh: 我又一次出现在 Ayane 的豪华轿车后座上，完全不记得自己是怎么到这儿来的。但这种事对我来说已经不值得大惊小怪了。

lines.en: The day went by like a flash of lightning, and it is I who now feel the burn of electricity as it courses through my veins and reminds me that places like this are my least favorite in all of the world.
lines.zh: 这一天快得像一道闪电，而现在轮到我来感受那阵灼烧——它顺着血管奔流，提醒着我，这样的地方是全世界我最讨厌的地方。

lines.en: I think about becoming a circuit and grounding these memories so that the two girls unfortunate enough to accompany me in this vehicle make it out alive...
lines.zh: 我想过变成一束电路，把这些记忆导入地下，好让不幸陪我同乘这辆车的两个姑娘能活着出去……

lines.en: But my lack of knowledge in terms of electricity prevents me from doing anything but sitting still and waiting for the car ride to come to an end.
lines.zh: 可惜我在电学上的无知，让我除了坐稳不动、等着这段车程结束之外，什么都做不了。

lines.en: I can tell that part of the day has disappeared. And an ever-powerful loneliness that sprouts from the ground as a result of that wraps around my ankles in an attempt to pull me under.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到，这一天里有部分时间消失了。而由此从地面生长出来的、一种无比强大的孤独，缠上我的脚踝，试图把我拽下去。

lines.en: Something is missing, but not completely gone.
lines.zh: 有什么东西不见了，但并没有彻底消失。

lines.en: It sits among us, watching on as the seer it is. Studying our every move and taking bets on what comes next.
lines.zh: 它就坐在我们中间，以它那先见者的身份旁观着。研究着我们的每一个动作，还为我们接下来的发展下注。

lines.en: I sink further into my seat, hoping to fall through the floor and have the tires of this vehicle kiss the back of my head and join me forever with the asphalt.
lines.zh: 我往座位里陷得更深，盼着自己能穿过地板，让车轮亲吻我的后脑，让我永远与柏油路合为一体。

lines.en: It is there where I can feel as if I belong again.
lines.zh: 在那里，我才能重新感觉到自己有所归属。

lines.en: I think for a moment about whether or not anything valuable was missed in this recurring slip into the dark. I think for another about anything I may have potentially fractured in doing so.
lines.zh: 我想了一会儿，在这次又一次滑入黑暗的过程中，是否错过了什么有价值的东西。我又想了一会儿，自己这么做是否可能弄碎了什么。

lines.en: But judging by the faces on the girls before me, I assure myself that nothing was fractured at all.
lines.zh: 但看看面前两个姑娘的表情，我安慰自己，什么都没弄碎。

lines.en: Either that or the two of them have grown so used to me destroying everything in my path that the smallest of breaks do not even register anymore.
lines.zh: 要么就是她们两个已经习惯了我把路上的一切都毁掉，连最小的裂纹都懒得再登记了。

lines.en: Part of me feels like I have been here before.
lines.zh: 我有一部分的自己觉得，我以前来过这里。

lines.en: Like I have thought these same thoughts under different circumstances.
lines.zh: 觉得我在不同的境况下想过同样的念头。
也许换了一具身体。

lines.en: But they dissipate the moment the passenger side tires come into contact with a small pothole- and any thoughts that may have led anywhere disappear like one more layer of cement.
lines.zh: 但当副驾驶那侧的车轮压上一个小坑洼时，这些念头就消散了——任何本可能通向某处的思绪，都像又一层水泥般消失了。

lines.en: : Sensei, you wouldn’t mind seeing Sana back to the dorm, would you? Molly will be starting on our Halloween costumes soon, so I need to head back home for a little while to grab some supplies.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你送 Sana 回宿舍不介意吧？Molly 马上要开始做我们的万圣节服装了，所以我得先回家拿点材料。

lines.en: : I don’t...need a babysitter, you know...
lines.zh: : 我……不需要保姆的，你知道的……

lines.en: : Of course I know. But you do need to take your eyes off of that screen for at least a few minutes today. You’re making Sensei feel lonely.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道。但你今天至少得让眼睛离开那块屏幕几分钟吧。你让 Sensei 觉得寂寞了。

lines.en: : If Sana doesn’t want me to go with her, that’s fine. I can just head home and she can keep playing her game.
lines.zh: : 如果 Sana 不想让我陪，那也没关系。我直接回家就行，她可以继续打她的游戏。
: 不，那个……没事……Ayane 说得对……

lines.en: : I’ve been...too much of a loner all day and...that isn’t fair to either one of you...
lines.zh: : 我……一整天都太独来独往了，而且……那对你们两个都不公平……

lines.en: : I just got a little...carried away, I guess...but...but I’m not tired, so...
lines.zh: : 我只是有点……玩过头了，我想……但是……但是我不困，所以……

lines.en: : So if you don’t...want to go home yet...
lines.zh: : 所以如果你还……不想回家的话……

lines.en: : Then, it’s settled! Sensei will accompany Sana back to the dorm and I will go home to my bathrobe-wearing, smooth-jazz and whiskey-obsessed father!
lines.zh: : 那么，就这么定了！Sensei 送 Sana 回宿舍，我回我那个穿着浴袍、痴迷于轻柔爵士和威士忌的老爸家！

lines.en: : That is a very interesting combination of traits.
lines.zh: : 这组合还真是别致。

lines.en: : You know, I thought so too. But the more I looked into it, the more I realized that all three of those things go hand in hand...and hand. Since there are three.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也觉得。但我越琢磨越发现，这三样东西简直是手拉着手……还多出一只手。毕竟有三样嘛。

lines.en: : Um...are...are you sure you want to come over, though?...
lines.zh: : 呃……不过……你确定要来吗？……

lines.en: : It’s...already really late and...I know Ami doesn’t like it when you’re...um...more than...five feet away from her...
lines.zh: : 已经……很晚了，而且……我知道 Ami 不喜欢你……呃……离她超过……五英尺……

lines.en: : I’ll come. I feel a sudden need to make up for lost time anyway.
lines.zh: : 我去。反正我突然有种想弥补失去的时间的冲动。

lines.en: : Yeah, where did you go after you left me? I thought you were going to look for Sana, but she said she never even saw you.
lines.zh: : 对啊，你离开我之后去哪儿了？我以为你去找 Sana 了，可她说根本没见过你。
: 我真希望我知道。

lines.en: : Um...sorry again for...not spending any time with you guys today...
lines.zh: : 呃……再次抱歉……今天没怎么陪你们……
: 我……呃……你知道的……
: 新游戏……

lines.en: : It’s not like you’re obligated to spend time with me or anything. There’s no need to apologize.
lines.zh: : 你又没有义务非得陪我。不用道歉。

lines.en: : I’m apologizing less for...not spending time with you and...more for just...being rude...
lines.zh: : 我道歉与其说是为了……没陪你，不如说是为了……就是……太失礼了……

lines.en: : To Ayane too...She invited me to the beach and...I didn’t even...do anything...beach-related...
lines.zh: : 对 Ayane 也是……她邀请我来海边，而我……连一点……跟海边有关的事都没做……

lines.en: : You wore a swimsuit which, honestly, is more than I would have expected out of you. So you’re in the clear.
lines.zh: : 你穿了泳衣啊，说实话，这已经比我对你期待的要多。所以你过关了。

lines.en: : I...uhh...kind of wish I didn’t, though...
lines.zh: : 不过我……呃……有点希望自己没穿……

lines.en: : If you’re only thinking that because I got to see more of your skin than ever before, you should take solace in the fact that it was only for a few seconds before you disappeared.
lines.zh: : 如果你只是因为我看到了比以往更多的你露出的皮肤才这么想，那你可以宽慰一下自己：你在我看到之后几秒钟就消失了。

lines.en: : I guess that makes...two of us, then...
lines.zh: : 那大概……我们两个都一样了……

lines.en: : We both...got to disappear while...Ayane stayed as noticeable as ever...
lines.zh: : 我们都……消失了，而……Ayane 还是一如既往地显眼……

lines.en: : I have a history of disappearing, though. You’re normally more of a “fade into the background” type of person. We’re very clearly not on the same level.
lines.zh: : 不过我一直都有消失的前科。你通常更像那种“渐渐隐入背景”的人。我们显然不在一个级别上。

lines.en: : We...found each other in the end, though...
lines.zh: : 可我们……最后还是找到了彼此……

lines.en: : Now we just have to...figure out what to do without...being awkward...
lines.zh: : 现在我们只要……想清楚接下来该怎么办，而又不……尴尬……

lines.en: : I feel like every single time we’ve hung out in here, things have been kind of awkward. I say we just embrace it and accept that’s how things will always be between the two of us.
lines.zh: : 我感觉我们每次在这儿一起待着，气氛都有点尴尬。不如就这么认了吧，接受我们之间永远都是这样。
: Sana？

lines.en: : Oh! S...Sorry, I...was just...thinking out loud...
lines.zh: : 哦！对……对不起，我……只是在……自言自语……

lines.en: : Do you, um...do you want to watch a...movie or something?...
lines.zh: : 你，呃……你想看部……电影什么的吗？……

lines.en: : Ahh, yes. What better way to give your eyes a break from staring at a screen all day than to just...stare at a different kind of screen?
lines.zh: : 啊，好啊。让你的眼睛从盯了一天的屏幕上休息一下，最好的办法就是……去盯另一种屏幕？

lines.en: : Don’t worry...only 50%% of my eyes...will suffer irreparable damage...
lines.zh: : 别担心……我的眼睛只有 50%% 会……遭受不可修复的损伤……

lines.en: : The benefits of being a cyclops.
lines.zh: : 当独眼龙的好处。
: 嘿嘿……

lines.en: : It’s much different from...having four eyes, I bet...
lines.zh: : 那跟有……四只眼睛的感觉肯定很不一样吧……

lines.en: : Are you actually making fun of me for wearing glasses right now?
lines.zh: : 你这是在拿我戴眼镜这件事开涮吗？

lines.en: : No...I like your glasses...they...they make you look...kind of sophisticated...like a real teacher...
lines.zh: : 没有……我喜欢你的眼镜……它们……它们让你看起来……挺有学识的……像个真正的老师……

lines.en: : But, um...we should...probably...stop just...staring at each other and...actually watch a movie if...if you’re not going to spend the night...
lines.zh: : 不过，呃……我们也许该……别再……光盯着对方看了，真的看部电影吧，如果……如果你不打算过夜的话……

lines.en: : Do you want me to spend the night?
lines.zh: : 你想让我过夜吗？
: 我想……
: 不回答这个问题……

lines.en: Something feels different about the air in here.
lines.zh: 这屋里的空气感觉不一样了。
更稠。
更热。

lines.en: And the way it fills my lungs makes it feel like an aphrodisiac.
lines.zh: 而它填满我肺部的那种方式，让人觉得像是一剂春药。

lines.en: I wonder if Sana ever steals glances at me while I’m looking away. And I wonder if her mind races to the same place mine does when I do the same for her.
lines.zh: 我好奇 Sana 会不会在我看向别处时偷偷瞄我。我也好奇，当我这样看她时，她的脑子会不会也奔向和我一样的地方。

lines.en: I wonder where it would go now if I were to take a sledgehammer to one of the only “pure” relationships I have maintained up until this point in exchange for just one more notch in my belt.
lines.zh: 我好奇，如果我用一把大锤砸碎至今为止我仅存的那几段“纯粹”关系之一，只为在自己的战绩上再多添一笔，事情会走到哪一步。

lines.en: Would it be worth it if it etched a notch into hers?
lines.zh: 如果代价是在她身上也刻下一道痕迹，那值得吗？

lines.en: Would she follow in her mother’s footsteps? Crumble beneath the touch of an older man?
lines.zh: 她会步她母亲的后尘吗？在一个年长男人的触碰下崩塌？

lines.en: Carry the burden he places in her for a whole nine months...grow to love it and refuse to let it go when its time finally comes?
lines.zh: 怀着他放进她体内的重担整整九个月……然后爱上它，在它终于该离开的时候死活不放手？

lines.en: Or would she rather drown herself in the semen of the status quo? Refusing to accept that the entire world is passing her by while she sits idly and pretends it’s all screeched to a halt.
lines.zh: 还是说，她宁愿溺死在现状的精液里？拒绝承认整个世界正从她身边呼啸而过，而她只是干坐着，假装一切都已急刹车停住。
这很糟。

lines.en: We’re half an hour into whatever it is we’re watching and I haven’t even been able to focus long enough to discern the title of the film.
lines.zh: 我们看的那个什么东西已经放了半小时了，我甚至都没能集中到看清片名。
她也一样吗？
她自在吗？
如果是，为什么？
怎么做到的？
为什么我就不能自在？

lines.en: Why can’t I keep things the way they are?
lines.zh: 为什么我就不能让一切保持原样？

lines.en: Why must all of my relationships end with sweat and cum? Drenched sheets and the flood of regret that never ceases pouring in once the dam bursts?
lines.zh: 为什么我所有的关系都必须以汗和精液收场？湿透的床单，以及大堤一旦决口就再也不停的悔恨洪流？
四十五分钟，还在继续。
Sana 不动了。

lines.en: I think she’s waiting for me to do something.
lines.zh: 我觉得她在等我做点什么。

lines.en: My dick has been pressed up against my jeans and damp, pre-cum soaked spot for so long that I’m worried I may develop some sort of blister.
lines.zh: 我的鸡巴顶在牛仔裤上、抵着那块被前列腺液浸湿的地方太久，我担心自己会磨出个水泡来。

lines.en: But thinking this does not quell the sexual rage stirring within me.
lines.zh: 但想到这个并没有平息我体内翻涌的性欲。
四十七。
她又动了。
她的肩膀蹭到了我的肩膀。

lines.en: Is she trying to hint at something?
lines.zh: 她是在暗示什么吗？

lines.en: How many more minutes should I wait before bumping into hers as well?
lines.zh: 我还该再等几分钟，才去撞一下她的肩膀？
四十八。
四十九。
五十。
我受不了了。
搂住她

lines.en: I reach out and rest my hand on her side, just inches from her lower back.
lines.zh: 我伸出手，把手掌搭在她身侧，离她的后腰只有几英寸。

lines.en: She does not move or twitch or react at all.
lines.zh: 她没有动，没有颤，一点反应都没有。

lines.en: My touch is either entirely welcome or entirely unnoticed.
lines.zh: 我的触碰要么完全受欢迎，要么完全没被注意到。

lines.en: I can’t tell which one I prefer.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己更想要哪一种。
: Sen——

lines.en: She moves closer of her own volition, bringing one of her own hands to my thigh and softly stroking it.
lines.zh: 她自己主动靠了过来，把她的一只手放到我大腿上，轻轻抚摸着。

lines.en: If she moves any further upward, she’ll realize how I feel.
lines.zh: 如果她再往上挪一点，她就会知道我的感觉了。

lines.en: The last fifty- no. Fifty one minutes now will have not been for nothing.
lines.zh: 之前那五十——不，现在五十一分钟，就不会白费了。

lines.en: We’ll cement ourselves as more than who we are when we have tried our hardest to remain alone in the dark. Unnoticed.
lines.zh: 我们会把自己确立成比现在的自己更多的东西——尽管我们曾拼命想独自留在黑暗里，不被人注意。

lines.en: But we shan’t be blamed for the seeking of light when we’ve all but forgotten how it feels on our skin.
lines.zh: 但我们不该因为寻求光而被责怪，毕竟我们几乎已经忘了光落在皮肤上是什么感觉。
: 你感觉到什么了吗？
我把她拉得更近。
她的皮肤很烫。灼人。

lines.en: I can tell she feels the same way I do. Perhaps even moreso. But, despite that, the tiny hand on my thigh stops moving.
lines.zh: 我看得出她和我感受相同。也许比我更甚。但尽管如此，那只搁在我大腿上的小手停住了。

lines.en: She’s scared. Nervous. And I understand that.
lines.zh: 她害怕。紧张。而我理解。

lines.en: It’s her first time being this close to anyone.
lines.zh: 这是她第一次和任何人靠得这么近。

lines.en: Which means that it is up to me to take the initiative...even more than I have done thus far.
lines.zh: 也就是说，该由我来采取主动……比到目前为止更主动。
我凑得更近。

lines.en: The thickness of her hair and the massive differential in our height prevents me from being able to look into her eyes and drink in her fear.
lines.zh: 她浓密的头发，加上我们身高的巨大差距，让我没法看着她的眼睛、啜饮她的恐惧。

lines.en: But, in just several seconds, I will be drinking in her spit instead.
lines.zh: 但再过几秒钟，我就要啜饮她的口水了。

lines.en: I wonder what this one will taste like.
lines.zh: 我好奇这一位的味道会是什么样。

lines.en: I wonder how she’ll react to the sensation of my tongue twisting around hers.
lines.zh: 我好奇她会怎么反应——当我的舌头缠上她的舌头。
她会喜欢吗？
讨厌吗？

lines.en: Will she beg me to stop?
lines.zh: 她会求我停下吗？
求我再来？

lines.en: Will we end up beneath the covers or simply remain on top of them?
lines.zh: 我们最后会钻到被子底下，还是就留在被子上面？
她想要什么样？
她会吞下去吗？
她会潮吹吗？

lines.en: Has she even started growing hair yet?
lines.zh: 她连毛都长出来了吗？

lines.en: She’s small for her age, so there might be nothing there.
lines.zh: 以她的年纪来说她发育得偏小，所以那儿也许什么都没有。
我会喜欢那样吗？
讨厌吗？
接下来会发生什么？
: 唔姆？！

lines.en: : You’re so cute when you’re turned on.
lines.zh: : 你发情的时候真可爱。

lines.en: Sana takes my thumb into her mouth, fellating it with an impressive amount of skill and confidence for a girl  who’s yet to ever taste a cock.
lines.zh: Sana 把我的拇指含进嘴里，以一个从未尝过鸡巴的姑娘来说，口技的技巧和自信都相当惊人。

lines.en: Her tongue slides beneath it as her hands pull me deeper into her mouth, desperate to show me what she’s capable of doing.
lines.zh: 她的舌头在下面滑动，双手把我往她嘴里更深地拉，拼命想让我看看她能做到什么程度。

lines.en: My head parts from hers slightly so I can get a better look at her face, but I’m still unable to see her eyes.
lines.zh: 我的头稍稍离开她一些，好让我能看清她的脸，可我还是看不见她的眼睛。

lines.en: And while I want to tear my thumb from her mouth and replace it with my tongue, I worry about how the taste of myself could potentially ruin this long overdue experience.
lines.zh: 虽然我想把拇指从她嘴里抽出来、换上我的舌头，但我担心自己身上的味道可能会毁掉这场迟来太久的体验。
: 唔姆……
: 唔嗯啾~
: 阿姆夫……
: 好孩子，Sana……
: 就是这样……

lines.en: : You must really want it, huh?
lines.zh: : 你真的很想要啊，是不是？

lines.en: : All you had to do was ask, you know.
lines.zh: : 你只要开口就行，你知道的。
: Shen……shei？……

lines.en: I lift her chin to kiss her.
lines.zh: 我托起她的下巴，吻她。
而在那短暂的一瞬间——

lines.en: I am finally able to see her eyes.
lines.zh: 我终于能看见她的眼睛。

lines.en: It’s only a brief moment, though.
lines.zh: 不过那只是短暂的一瞬。

lines.en: It’s gone quicker than a flash of lightning.
lines.zh: 它消失得比闪电还快。

lines.en: : Stop stop stop stop stop stop stop! What are you doing?!
lines.zh: : 停停停停停停停！你在干什么？！
: 你不是——

lines.en: : You...you have to leave. Right now.
lines.zh: : 你……你得走了。现在就走。
: 现在？
: 现在。
: 如果我误解了什么，你——
: 就……走吧。求你了。

lines.en: : This is...this is happening...way too fast...and...
lines.zh: : 这一切……这一切发生得……太快了……而且……
: 我甚至都……不记得我们是怎么……
: 怎么就……
: 发生了……什么……
: 它就那么发生了……
: Sensei……我做不到……
: 我需要你走。

lines.en: : I need you to please go.
lines.zh: : 我需要你走，求你了。

lines.en: : We can...we can forget this ever happened...
lines.zh: : 我们可以……我们可以当这事从来没发生过……
: 你做得到吗？
: 什么？
: 这不就是你想要的吗？
: Sensei……
: 求你走吧……
: 求你了……

lines.en: It feels cold when I step outside, though I think it’s just the result of elevated body heat.
lines.zh: 我走出门的时候觉得很冷，不过我想那只是体温升高的结果。
我做错了吗？

lines.en: Everything seemed to be going fine until Sana just...changed her mind.
lines.zh: 一切看起来都很顺利，直到 Sana 突然……改了主意。
可是……

lines.en: Was that even Sana at all?
lines.zh: 那真的是 Sana 吗？

lines.en: And if not...what would that mean?
lines.zh: 如果不是……那意味着什么？

lines.en: What was that look she gave me right before we were about to kiss?
lines.zh: 就在我们快要吻上的前一刻，她看我的那个眼神是什么？

lines.en: How did it stop me dead in my tracks?
lines.zh: 它怎么就让我当场僵住了？
还有为什么我……

lines.en: Why do I want to see even more of it?
lines.zh: 为什么我想看到更多那样的东西？

lines.en: You’re probably tired of hearing this by now-
lines.zh: 你大概已经听烦了——

lines.en: But I slide my hands into my pockets and begin to head home.
lines.zh: 但我还是把手插进口袋，开始往家走。

lines.en: I can’t even text Sana to apologize as, for some reason, I still don’t have her phone number.
lines.zh: 我连给 Sana 发条消息道歉都做不到，因为不知为何，我到现在都还没有她的电话号码。

lines.en: Maybe she’s just afraid of letting me in.
lines.zh: 也许她只是害怕让我走进来。

lines.en: But she needs someone to protect her.
lines.zh: 但她需要有人保护她。

lines.en: She needs someone to fix her.
lines.zh: 她需要有人把她修好。

lines.en: And I’ve been successful so far.
lines.zh: 而到目前为止我一直很成功。

lines.en: Which means that this can’t be the end.
lines.zh: 也就是说，这不会是结局。

lines.en: I won’t let it be the end.
lines.zh: 我不会让它成为结局。

lines.en: But I’m not even sure it’s up to me anymore.
lines.zh: 但我甚至不确定这还由不由我决定。

lines.en: And I’m not sure if it’s up to her either.
lines.zh: 我也不确定是不是由她决定。

lines.en: I hope she’s doing okay right now.
lines.zh: 我希望她现在没事。
: MMM！MMM！MMM！MMM！MMM！！！！
: HNGH………MM！……MMMFFF!!!!
: MMF……AAMFH……MNNGHH!!!…………MMM!!!
: AAAAH!!……NGAHHH!!!!!
: 为什么……我这么…………啊啊啊!!!
: Sensei……Sensei……Sensei!!!
: 我们是怎么…………
: 为什么……我无法…………
: 哦操…………哦哦哦……操……

lines.en: : AAAAAH! RIGHT THERE! RIGHT THERE! RIGHT THERE!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊！就是那里！就是那里！就是那里！
: 更用力！……更用力!!!……
: SEN…………SEI!!!!
: MMF………MNGHH…………MMMMMMMMMM!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
走开！别那么做！求你了！

lines.en: The movie comes to an end...
lines.zh: 电影结束了……

lines.en: And I feel as if I have kept something alive.
lines.zh: 而我感觉自己像是让什么东西活了下来。

lines.en: But the sensation in doing so is not one of bliss.
lines.zh: 但这么做带来的感觉并不是极乐。

lines.en: It feels more like staring at the body of a loved one caught in a coma.
lines.zh: 它更像是凝视着陷入昏迷的至亲的身体。

lines.en: Like I’m prolonging an inevitability that I refuse to accept because drowning in the semen of the status quo is something I, too, indulge in from time to time.
lines.zh: 像是我在拖延一个我不愿接受的必然——因为溺死在现状的精液里，也是我偶尔会纵情享受的事。

lines.en: Do not cheer for me. Do not admire this desperate bout of indecisiveness- for even if this is an improvement, it is something someone normal would not be forced to face.
lines.zh: 别为我喝彩。别赞美这场绝望的优柔寡断——因为即便这算是一种进步，正常人也根本不会被逼到要面对这种事。

lines.en: The man who breaks everything should not be lauded when he comes into contact with an object that somehow remains intact.
lines.zh: 一个把一切都弄坏的人，不该因为碰到了一样居然完好无损的东西就受到称颂。
这个女孩，这样东西，她——
: 我想……
: 你该回家了，Sensei……
: 天色晚了……
: 但今晚……
: 很美好……
: 真的很美好……

lines.en: I left Sana’s room and wound up in my own.
lines.zh: 我离开了 Sana 的房间，最后回到了自己的房间。
这是正确的决定吗？

lines.en: What could I have taken if I had only reached out?
lines.zh: 如果我当时伸手了，我本可以拿走什么？

lines.en: Would I still be there right now? Spending the night in that small bed of hers while one much larger and more familiar sits directly beside us?
lines.zh: 我现在还会待在那儿吗？睡在她那张小床上，而一张更大、更熟悉的床就紧挨在我们旁边？

lines.en: There is no way of knowing.
lines.zh: 无从知晓。

lines.en: All I can do is trust my gut.
lines.zh: 我唯一能做的，就是相信自己的直觉。

lines.en: I just wish it would stop feeling like it’s wrapping around itself.
lines.zh: 我只希望它别再让我觉得，它在一圈圈地缠住自己。
Sana 的好感度提升了 10！

lines.en: You dream of her and only her.
lines.zh: 你梦见了她，只有她。

lines.en: But you’re unsure if you’ll ever dream that way again.
lines.zh: 但你不确定自己还能不能再这样梦一次。
